recipes.name: Vegan Persian Fesenjan
instructions: Bloom the saffron by sprinkling it over an ice cube set in a small bowl and letting it melt completely.
In a food processor, grind the walnuts until finely ground.
In a medium sauté pan, heat the oil over medium-high heat. Add the onion and cook for about 4 minutes, or until lightly golden.
Add the ground walnuts and toast, stirring often, for 2 to 3 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste, turmeric, cinnamon, salt, and pepper and cook for 1 to 2 minutes to allow the spices to toast and become fragrant.
Pour in the saffron and its liquid, along with the vegetable broth, seitan, and pomegranate molasses.
Cover, reduce the heat to medium-low, and simmer gently, stirring occasionally, for 20 minutes to let the flavors develop.

Meanwhile, combine the rice and water in a medium saucepan. Cover with a lid, bring to a boil, then lower to a simmer and cook for 12 to 15 minutes, or until the water is absorbed and the rice is tender. Let sit, covered, for a few minutes before fluffing with a fork*.
Serve the fesenjān alongside warm rice. If desired, garnish with cilantro and pomegranate seeds. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes * Optionally, to tint part of the rice yellow, grind a small pinch of saffron threads and steep in hot water for 5 to 10 minutes. When the rice is cooked, mix the saffron liquid with a small portion of the rice to color it yellow. Use it as a garnish or mix it back into the rest of the rice.
Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 5 days. Freeze for up to 2 months.
